observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'fat' model with a matte and glossy split top.
Two DualShock 4 controllers: one in 'Berry Blue' (light blue/red) and one in 'Midnight Blue' (dark blue/purple).
The controllers have protective plastic film on the touchpads.
The PlayStation 'PS' logo is visible on the top of the console.
A watermark for 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is present on the image.
Only one photo is provided, showing a top-down view of the items.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the original thick chassis design of the PlayStation 4.
No photo of the system software version or homebrew menu is provided.
No photo of the console's user interface or home screen showing installed games.
The exterior surfaces in photo 0 appear clean and free of major scratches.
The warranty seals on the rear of the console are not shown.
Third-party clones of these specific colors are common; rear labels are not shown.
The receipt is mentioned but not pictured.

risks.risk: Firmware version is higher than 11.00 (not hackable).
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > System > System Information.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard non-hacked console

risks.risk: Console has been opened or repaired (broken warranty seals).
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the console showing the screw covers/seals.

risks.risk: Controllers are third-party clones or have stick drift.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear labels and a video of the controllers in use.
Video of a disc being inserted, read, and ejected.

proof_requests: Screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the rear of the console showing the warranty seals.
Photo of the console's home screen showing the installed games.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the description.
Close-up photos of the labels on the back of both controllers.
response.reason: A single top-down photo is insufficient to verify the 'hacked' status or the physical integrity (seals) of the console. Since the hacked status is the primary value driver for this model and no non-hacked PS4 comparables are available to establish a 'worst-case' price, further proof is required.
